evidence.quote: La formation sera dispensée en Français avec une proportion croissante des cours en Anglais en L2 puis en L3 (semestre à l’étranger ERASMUS en L2)

notes: The programme page does not list specific documents for international applicants; the CV mentioned on the Campus France cost page is not clearly required for this programme. Tuition of 178 EUR/year appears in the Parcoursup fiche, but Campus France states differentiated tuition of 2902 EUR/year for non-EU students in Licence; the applicable amount may be 2902 EUR unless the institution grants an exemption. Teaching languages are French and English (growing share in English). The requirement for English B1 is stated as minimum, B2 recommended. A .docx file with the required documents was missing.
